title: AuditEventMessage
description: The immutable record of one security-relevant action (who did what, to which tenant's data, and when), published under an audit.<action> routing key. Not a notification: unlike the *.changed events it is never used to re-check current state, and Audit.Service stores it verbatim. See docs/architecture/16-auditing-and-compliance.md. metadata is action-specific and must never carry a secret, a JWT, a plaintext credential or a raw log payload.

eventId.description: Idempotency key: Audit.Service drops a second event with the same id.

occurredAt.description: Set by the producing service when the action happened.

tenantId.description: Null for pre-tenant events such as a login.

id.description: Keycloak subject for a User, the agent credential id for a Device.

action.description: Dotted lower-case action name, e.g. role.assigned or router.credential.fetched. The routing key is audit.<action>.

metadata.description: Action-specific detail (identifiers and before/after of what changed); never a secret value.
